description.value: Brennan Park Recreation Centre is Squamish's municipal multi-sport facility, hosting a swimming pool, ice hockey rink, and skating arena in the heart of one of BC's premier outdoor adventure towns. As a District of Squamish facility it is fully wheelchair accessible with accessible washrooms. Touring cyclists passing through Squamish would find it a practical stop for public amenities in a well-maintained civic building.
